function.name: find_patient_by_phone
function.description: Look up whether a patient already exists with this phone number. Call this as soon as the caller gives a valid 10-digit phone number, before collecting the rest of their details.

phone_number.description: The caller's 10-digit U.S. phone number, digits only, e.g. 2125550143.

function.name: create_patient
function.description: Register a new patient. Only call this after reading all details back to the caller and receiving clear confirmation that everything is correct.

last_name.description: Patient last name, spelled as confirmed by the caller.

date_of_birth.description: Date of birth in MM/DD/YYYY format.

email.description: Email address. Omit if not provided.

address_line_2.description: Apartment, suite, or unit. Omit if none.

state.description: Two-letter U.S. state code, e.g. TX.

insurance_provider.description: Insurance company name. Omit if not provided.

insurance_member_id.description: Insurance member or subscriber ID. Omit if not provided.

emergency_contact_name.description: Emergency contact full name. Omit if not provided.

emergency_contact_phone.description: Emergency contact 10-digit phone number, digits only. Omit if not provided.

messages.content: Just a moment, still saving that for you.

function.name: update_patient
function.description: Update an existing patient's record. Only call this for a returning caller whose date of birth matched the record, after reading back the changes and receiving clear confirmation. Send only the fields that changed.

messages.content: Just a moment, still updating that for you.
